verdict.rationale: Phoenix ships a first-party remote MCP server at the instance's `/mcp` endpoint. Any MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and others) can connect to it and search, query, and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations. A documented `px setup mcp --agent <claude|codex|gemini|cursor|opencode|vscode>` command wires up the connection. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
